name: Flowtide
summary: Automatic payments for a small studio: self-chasing invoices, pots and a visual flow builder
about: A complete payments and money app for a studio, agency or small business, in bright studio gradients with a light and a dark theme. Invoices chase themselves, freelancers are paid in batches from a payroll pot, and every client payment pours into Tax, Profit, Payroll and Operating pots in an animated money river. The automation builder shows each flow as steps you add, edit, reorder and switch off, and a test run sends a glowing token through them before the actions really happen.
how: Press Simulate a payment on Overview and watch the money river split it into pots
Open Automations, add a step from the menu, drag steps to swap them, then press Test run
Mark an invoice paid, send it, remind now or turn auto-chasing on and off
Tick freelancers on Payouts and pay them in one batch with a progress bar
Move money between pots with a confirm step, set goals and freeze the studio card
Switch report ranges, export invoices and activity, and change reminder timing in Settings
